$schema: Coqui source map — describes every core source file so the agent can understand its own codebase.

layers.agent: Agent classes — the orchestrator and child agent implementations
layers.command: Symfony Console commands — CLI entry points and REPL loop
layers.config: Configuration, safety, and discovery — workspace management, credential resolution, toolkit discovery
layers.contract: Interfaces and value objects — the contracts that define extensibility points
layers.tool: Tools — individual capabilities the agent can invoke during conversation
layers.toolkit: Toolkits — groups of related tools with shared guidelines
layers.observer: Observers — real-time event rendering for terminal output
layers.storage: Storage — SQLite-backed session and audit persistence
layers.coqui-space: Coqui Space — marketplace integration for discovering, installing, and managing skills and toolkits

files.description: Top-level orchestrator agent. Extends AbstractAgent. Registers all toolkits (FilesystemToolkit, ShellToolkit with configurable allowlist, MemoryToolkit, ProjectSourceToolkit, ToolkitGeneratorToolkit, SkillToolkit, auto-discovered toolkits) and all standalone tools (spawn_agent, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, summarize_conversation). Shell allowlist is resolved from agents.defaults.shellAllowedCommands in openclaw.json or falls back to DEFAULT_SHELL_COMMANDS (includes curl, wget). Memory is SQLite-backed via MemoryStore with FTS5 full-text search and optional vector embeddings; core memory summary is auto-injected into instructions(). Resolves a ContextWindow from ModelDefinition at construction time and passes it to AbstractAgent for per-iteration token budget enforcement. Constructed fresh on every REPL turn.
methods: instructions(): string — returns the full system prompt with role descriptions, security rules, and operational guidelines
tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns standalone tools (spawn, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, summarize_conversation)
requiredCapabilities(): ModelCapability[] — Text + Tools
getSpawnTool(): SpawnAgentTool — accessor for iteration tracking
resolveContextWindow(): ?ContextWindowInterface — resolves ContextWindow from ModelDefinition with 128K/4K fallback
getContextWindow(): ?ContextWindowInterface — accessor for the resolved context window

files.description: Flexible child agent spawned by SpawnAgentTool. Receives role, task instructions, and toolkits at construction time. Loads role instructions from file-based roles via RoleDiscovery, falling back to hardcoded instructions for backward compatibility.
methods: instructions(): string — resolves role instructions from file or hardcoded fallback + task injection
requiredCapabilities(): ModelCapability[] — Text + Tools
getRole(): string — returns the agent's role

files.description: Handles agent creation, execution, and turn message persistence. Manages the full turn lifecycle: creates a turn record before execution, tracks timing, extracts tool usage and child agent counts, and completes the turn with all metadata after execution. Includes autoSummarizeIfNeeded() for pre-turn budget checks, and autoExtractMemories() which runs LLM-based memory extraction after each successful turn (configurable via agents.defaults.memory.autoExtract).
methods: run(string $prompt, string $sessionId, ToolExecutionPolicyInterface $executionPolicy): AgentTurnResult — runs a single agent turn using the default observer
runWithObserver(string $prompt, string $sessionId, ToolExecutionPolicyInterface $executionPolicy, SplObserver $observer): AgentTurnResult — runs a turn with a per-turn observer override
runForTask(..., ?string $role, ?int $maxIterations): AgentTurnResult — runs a background task with specified role and iteration limit
createAgent(..., ?SplObserver $observer, string $role, ?int $maxIterations): OrchestratorAgent — builds the orchestrator agent with role-resolved model and iteration limit
autoSummarizeIfNeeded(OrchestratorAgent, Conversation, string $sessionId, ?SplObserver): Conversation — checks token budget and auto-summarizes if threshold exceeded
autoExtractMemories(Conversation, string $sessionId): void — runs LLM-based memory extraction from completed turn

files.description: Lightweight tool resolver and executor for background tool tasks. Builds the same toolkits as OrchestratorAgent (filesystem, shell, memory, project source, PHP execute, discovered packages) but without creating an agent or involving an LLM. Finds a tool by name from the collected toolkit tools and calls execute() directly. Used by TaskRunCommand when a task record has tool_name set.
methods: execute(string $toolName, array $arguments): ToolResult — resolve tool and call execute() directly
hasTool(string $toolName): bool — check if a tool exists in the index

files.description: Main Symfony Console command ('run'). Boots the entire system: loads config, resolves workspace, initializes WorkspaceComposerManager, ToolkitDiscovery, SessionStorage, then runs the REPL loop. Handles CLI flags --unsafe, --auto-approve, --update, --config, --new, --session, --workdir. Contains gated tools definition, approval policy construction with mergeGatedTools() combining hardcoded + package-declared gates, restart logic (RESTART_EXIT_CODE = 10, restartRequested flag), startup update checking (COQUI_CHECK_UPDATES, COQUI_AUTO_UPDATE env vars), and background task REPL commands (/tasks, /task, /task-cancel).
methods: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — main entry point; boots system and enters REPL loop

handleCommand(string, SymfonyStyle): int|true — processes REPL commands (/new, /history, /sessions, /resume, /model, /tasks, /task, /task-cancel, /help, /restart, /quit); returns exit code or true to continue
runAgent(string, SymfonyStyle): void — creates OrchestratorAgent with restart callback, runs agent turn, checks restartRequested flag
listTasksCommand(?string $statusFilter, SymfonyStyle $io): void — /tasks command: lists tasks with optional status filter
taskStatusCommand(string $idPrefix, SymfonyStyle $io): void — /task command: shows detailed task status with events
taskCancelCommand(string $idPrefix, SymfonyStyle $io): void — /task-cancel command: cancels pending or running tasks
resolveTaskByPrefix(string $prefix): ?array — resolves a task by ID prefix match
mergeGatedTools(): array — merges hardcoded GATED_TOOLS with package-declared extra.php-agents.gated from ToolkitDiscovery

files.description: Standalone 'setup' command that runs the SetupWizard to create or overwrite openclaw.json.
methods: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — runs the interactive setup wizard

files.description: Diagnostic 'doctor' command that checks 10 health categories: PHP environment (version, extensions, memory, putenv), config (openclaw.json validity, primary model, roles), workspace (directory, writable, composer.json, autoloader), database (existence, connection, tables, stats, message integrity with per-session UTF-8 scan), credentials (.env existence, permissions), providers (Ollama connectivity + model listing, cloud API key presence), toolkits (installed.json validity, class autoloadability), skills (directory, SKILL.md presence), launcher (bin/coqui-launcher executable), and disk space. Supports --repair flag to auto-fix issues (create missing dirs, init composer.json, fix .env permissions, repair malformed UTF-8 in messages, delete unfixable rows). Supports --json for machine-readable output.
methods: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — runs all checks and prints results; exit 0=OK, 1=warnings, 2=errors
checkPhpEnvironment(): void — PHP version, required extensions, memory_limit, putenv availability
checkConfig(): void — openclaw.json existence, JSON validity, primary model, agent roles
checkWorkspace(): void — workspace directory existence, writability, composer.json, autoloader, subdirectories
checkDatabase(): void — SQLite file, connection, required tables, stats, per-session message integrity scan with repair
checkCredentials(): void — .env existence, permissions (0600), configured key count
checkProviders(): void — Ollama HTTP connectivity + model listing, cloud API key presence
checkToolkits(): void — installed.json validity, toolkit class autoloadability
checkSkills(): void — skills directory, SKILL.md presence per skill
checkLauncher(): void — bin/coqui-launcher existence and executable permission
checkDiskSpace(): void — free disk space on workspace partition

files.description: ToolExecutionPolicyInterface implementation. Auto-approves all tool executions except catastrophic blacklist matches. Used when --auto-approve CLI flag is passed. All decisions are logged to the audit_log table with turn_id linkage.
methods: shouldExecute(string $toolName, array $arguments): true|string — returns true to allow, or denial reason string. Forwards turnId to logAudit.

files.description: Hardcoded regex patterns for destructive commands (rm -rf /, shutdown, fork bombs, dd, curl | bash, etc.) that can NEVER be bypassed. Also supports user additions via agents.defaults.blacklist in openclaw.json.
methods: isBlocked(string $command): bool — checks command against all patterns
getMatchedPattern(string $command): ?string — returns the matched pattern or null

files.description: CredentialResolverInterface implementation. Reads/writes workspace .env file. No caching — re-reads on every get() for hot-reload. set() calls putenv() for immediate availability. File permissions set to 0600.
methods: get(string $key): ?string — reads credential from .env, returns null if missing
has(string $key): bool — checks if credential exists
set(string $key, string $value): void — writes to .env AND calls putenv()
delete(string $key): void — removes from .env and unsets env var
loadIntoProcessEnv(): void — loads all .env values into process environment
keys(): string[] — returns all stored key names
envPath(): string — returns the .env file path

files.description: Manages directory mount symlinks in workspace/mnt/. Creates/updates/cleans symlinks on boot. Generates allowedPaths arrays for FilesystemToolkit (orchestrator gets declared access, child agents forced read-only), a markdown storage map for prompt injection, and open_basedir path lists for PhpExecuteTool.
methods: initialize(): void — creates mnt/ dir, creates/updates symlinks, cleans stale links
allowedPaths(): array — returns [{realPath, readOnly}] with declared access levels
allowedPathsReadOnly(): array — returns [{realPath, readOnly: true}] for child agents
storageMap(): string — markdown table of mounts for system prompt injection
openBasedirPaths(): string[] — real paths for PhpExecuteTool open_basedir extension
hasMounts(): bool — whether any mounts are registered

files.description: Validated value object for a directory mount declaration. Enforces: path must exist as a directory, alias must not contain path separators, access must be 'ro' or 'rw'. Factory method fromArray() parses config entries from openclaw.json.
methods: fromArray(array $data): self — factory for config parsing, validates all fields
isReadOnly(): bool — returns true when access is 'ro'

files.description: Loads and provides typed access to config/defaults.json. Centralizes all hardcoded defaults (providers, models, base URLs, roles) into a single editable JSON file shipped with the package.
methods: providerNames(): string[] — all provider keys (ollama, openai, anthropic, openrouter, xai)
provider(string $name): array — full provider config block
providers(): array — all providers and their configurations
defaultBaseUrl(string $provider): string — default API base URL
requiresApiKey(string $provider): bool — whether the provider needs an API key
curatedModels(string $provider): array — list of recommended models
roleDefinitions(): array — all role definitions with descriptions
defaultModel(): string — default model string (provider/model)
defaultWorkspace(): string — default workspace directory path

files.description: ToolExecutionPolicyInterface implementation. Prompts user for confirmation on gated tools. Catastrophic blacklist checked first (no prompt — just blocked). Gated tools configured via $gatedTools map (tool name → rule list). Supports four rule types: wildcard ['*'], action-string matching, predicate objects {'arg': value}, and presence checks {'arg': '*'}. Rules use OR semantics; predicate internals use AND. Forwards turnId to logAudit.
methods: shouldExecute(string $toolName, array $arguments): true|string — prompts user, returns true to allow or denial reason. Forwards turnId to logAudit.
requiresApproval(string $toolName, array $arguments): bool — evaluates gating rules including predicate matching
matchesPredicate(array $predicate, array $arguments): bool — checks argument predicates with AND semantics

files.description: Maps role names to provider/model strings and resolves per-role iteration limits. Model priority: role file model field → openclaw.json → primary model. Iteration priority: role file max_iterations → agents.defaults.maxIterations → DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS (25). resolveUtility() provides a unified utility model chain: agents.defaults.model.utility → COQUI_UTILITY_MODEL env → title-generator role → primary model. toArray() returns enriched metadata with display_name, description, access_level, max_iterations.
methods: resolve(string $role): string — returns provider/model string (file model → config → primary)
resolveUtility(): string — returns utility model string (config utility → env → title-generator → primary)
resolveMaxIterations(string $role): int — returns iteration limit (role file → openclaw.json → 25). 0 = unlimited
availableRoles(): string[] — union of config and discovered role names
toArray(): array — enriched role-to-model mapping with metadata and max_iterations

files.description: Static analysis of generated PHP code. Blocks dangerous functions (eval, exec, system, passthru, shell_exec, proc_open, etc.) and filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, fopen, mkdir, unlink, rename, copy, etc.) to prevent writes to the project root. Also blocks patterns (backtick execution, privilege escalation, pipe to shell). In --unsafe mode, only catastrophic patterns are enforced.
methods: validate(string $code): string[] — returns array of issue descriptions (empty means safe)
isUnsafe(): bool — whether running in unsafe mode

files.description: BudgetPruningStrategyInterface implementation that summarizes older conversation turns via ConversationSummarizer before dropping them. Falls back to DefaultBudgetPruningStrategy on failure or when no provider is available. If summarization alone doesn't reduce tokens enough, applies default pruning on top.
methods: prune(Conversation $conversation, int $budgetTokens): Conversation — attempts LLM summarization then default pruning as fallback

files.description: Interactive wizard for building openclaw.json. Steps: select providers → configure each (base URL, API key, model discovery) → assign roles → set primary model → configure workspace. Supports live model discovery via Ollama/OpenAI APIs.
methods: run(): array — runs the interactive wizard, returns the generated config array

files.description: Discovers ToolkitInterface implementations from installed Composer packages. Checks extra.php-agents.toolkits in package composer.json. Persists discovered toolkits in toolkits.json registry. Scans both project and workspace vendor directories. Wraps toolkits with CredentialGuardToolkit when credential requirements are declared. Reads extra.php-agents.gated declarations for destructive-command gating.
methods: discover(string $packageName): string[] — scan a single package for toolkit classes
discoverAll(): array — scan all installed packages (project + workspace)
instantiateRegistered(): ToolkitInterface[] — instantiate all registered toolkit classes
register(string $packageName, string[] $classNames): void — persist toolkit registry
unregister(string $packageName): void — remove from registry
loadCredentialRequirements(string $packageName): CredentialRequirement[] — load credential declarations (supports string shorthand and object format with optional flag)
loadGatedTools(string $packageName): array — load gated tool declarations from extra.php-agents.gated
collectAllGatedTools(): array — merge gated tool declarations from all registered packages

files.description: Manages Coqui self-updates and workspace dependency updates. Checks for outdated packages via `composer outdated --format=json --direct` and applies updates via `composer update`. Path-repository packages (source.type=path / symlinks) are excluded from the outdated count since composer update cannot resolve them and they would otherwise cause an infinite auto-update restart loop. After applyUpdates(), RunCommand re-checks the count and only triggers a restart if the outdated count actually decreased. Controlled by COQUI_CHECK_UPDATES and COQUI_AUTO_UPDATE env vars stored in the workspace .env.
methods: isCheckEnabled(): bool — whether startup update checking is enabled (default: true)
isAutoUpdateEnabled(): bool — whether auto-update is enabled (default: false)
checkForUpdates(): UpdateCheckResult — checks project + workspace for outdated packages; excludes path-repo packages
applyUpdates(): UpdateCheckResult — runs composer update in project + workspace; captures both stdout and stderr for error reporting

files.description: Value object representing the result of an update check. Contains a list of outdated packages with current/latest versions, or an error message. Provides summary() for human-readable terminal display.
methods: none(): self — factory for no-updates result
error(string $message): self — factory for error result
summary(): string — formatted string for terminal display

files.description: Manages a separate Composer project inside the workspace directory (workspace/composer.json). The workspace has its own vendor/ so the bot can self-install packages without touching the user's main project.
methods: initialize(): void — creates scaffold composer.json if missing
loadAutoloader(): bool — loads workspace vendor/autoload.php
isInitialized(): bool — checks if composer.json exists
composerJsonPath(): string — path to workspace composer.json
workspacePath(): string — workspace root path

files.description: Resolves the workspace directory from openclaw.json config. Supports relative paths (resolved against project root), absolute paths, and ~ expansion. Default: ~/.coqui/.workspace. Creates directory and .gitkeep if missing.
methods: resolve(): string — returns the absolute workspace path

files.description: Centralized default values for Coqui configuration. Single source of truth for all default limits and thresholds (maxIterations, maxConcurrent, keepRecentTurns, autoSummarizeKeepRecent, autoSummarizeThreshold, context window fallbacks). All config fallbacks reference these constants instead of hardcoding values.

Final readonly value object representing a credential requirement: name (env var name) + description (human-readable) + optional flag. Used by the CredentialGuard system to declare what keys a toolkit needs. Optional credentials do not block tool execution when missing.
Interface for credential management with hot-reload support. Implementations must persist to .env and call putenv() on set() for immediate availability without restart.
methods: get(string $key): ?string
has(string $key): bool
set(string $key, string $value): void
delete(string $key): void
loadIntoProcessEnv(): void
keys(): string[]
envPath(): string

files.description: Final readonly value object for uploaded file metadata. Implements JsonSerializable — serialized form excludes storedPath for security. Tracks id, originalName, mimeType, size, isImage flag, storedPath (internal only), and createdAt.
methods: jsonSerialize(): array — returns public fields (excludes storedPath)

files.description: ToolInterface decorator that intercepts execute() and checks if required (non-optional) credentials exist. Returns structured error with exact key names and credentials tool call syntax when missing. Optional credentials are skipped — they do not block execution. The inner tool is never invoked when required credentials are missing.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — checks credentials, delegates to inner tool if all present

files.description: ToolkitInterface decorator that wraps all inner toolkit tools with CredentialGuardTool. Appends credential status (configured/MISSING/optional) to the guidelines string. Optional credentials show ○ indicator.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns wrapped tools
guidelines(): string — inner guidelines + credential status appendix

files.description: LLM-facing CRUD tool for credentials. Actions: set, get, list, delete. Values are never returned to the LLM after storing. Key names must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Delegates to CredentialResolverInterface.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to set/get/list/delete handlers

files.description: Introspects installed Composer packages on-demand. Actions: readme (8KB truncated), classes (reflection-based listing), methods (deep inspect with param/return types), source (read file, 12KB truncated). Lets the agent learn how to use an SDK without pre-injecting documentation.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to readme/classes/methods/source handlers

files.description: Executes generated PHP code in a sandboxed subprocess. cwd is workspace, open_basedir restricts filesystem access. ScriptSanitizer blocks filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, mkdir, unlink, etc.) at the static analysis level before code runs, preventing writes to the project root. Auto-prepends bootstrap preamble (strict_types, project + workspace autoloaders, .env loader). Output truncated to 32KB. Security: ScriptSanitizer (static check) + open_basedir (runtime restriction) + InteractiveApprovalPolicy (user confirmation) + timeout.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — sanitizes code, writes to temp file, runs via proc_open

files.description: Agent-facing tool that triggers a graceful restart of Coqui. Sets a restartRequested flag on RunCommand via a closure callback. After the current agent turn completes, the REPL loop checks the flag and exits with RESTART_EXIT_CODE (10). The launcher script detects this exit code and relaunches the process. Gated by execution policy — requires user confirmation unless --auto-approve is enabled.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — sets restart flag via closure, returns success message with reason

files.description: Agent-facing tool for image analysis. Wraps VisionAnalyzer to expose a vision_analyze tool that accepts an image source (file path, URL, or base64 data URI) and an optional prompt. Delegates model resolution, provider routing, and multimodal message construction to VisionAnalyzer. Detects 'Error: ' prefixed responses from VisionAnalyzer and returns them as ToolResult::error() so the agent sees specific failure reasons.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — validates image parameter, delegates to VisionAnalyzer, returns ToolResult::success() or ToolResult::error() with descriptive message

files.description: Agent-facing tool for on-demand conversation summarization. Exposes a summarize_conversation tool with scope (all/recent), keep_recent (1-20), and focus parameters. Resolves a cheap provider via utility model resolution (agents.defaults.model.utility → title-generator role → orchestrator fallback). Reads keepRecentTurns from agents.defaults.context.keepRecentTurns config. Delegates to ConversationSummarizer for the actual compression.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — validates parameters, resolves provider, delegates to ConversationSummarizer, returns summary metrics

files.description: Spawns child agents with role-specific models and toolkits. Uses RoleDiscovery access_level (full/readonly/minimal) to determine toolkit assignment, falling back to hardcoded defaults. Passes RoleDiscovery to ChildAgent for file-based role instructions. Accepts a configurable shell allowlist from OrchestratorAgent; child agents use DEFAULT_CHILD_SHELL_COMMANDS or the parent-supplied list.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — resolves role to model, builds toolkits, runs child agent
buildToolkits(string $role): ToolkitInterface[] — returns toolkits based on access_level with configurable shell allowlist
resolveAccessLevel(string $role): string — looks up access_level from RoleProperties
setCurrentIteration(int $iteration): void — tracks parent iteration for logging
getChildRunCount(): int — returns number of child agents spawned during this turn

files.description: Read-only toolkit providing structured access to the Coqui project source code. Tools: project_source_map (returns config/source.json), project_read (reads a file from project root), project_list (lists a directory), project_search (glob search). Enables the agent to understand and navigate its own codebase.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns project_source_map, project_read, project_list, project_search
guidelines(): string — usage instructions for project source access

files.description: Generates complete toolkit package scaffolds for Coqui. Tools: toolkit_create (scaffolds a new package with composer.json, toolkit class, README, runs composer install), toolkit_add_tool (inserts a new tool into an existing toolkit class), toolkit_list (lists workspace toolkit packages with metadata). All generated packages follow Coqui conventions and are auto-discoverable.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns toolkit_create, toolkit_add_tool, toolkit_list
guidelines(): string — usage instructions for toolkit generation workflow

files.description: ToolkitInterface implementation providing three tools: skill_list (browse available skills), skill_read (activate a skill by loading full instructions), skill_create (scaffold a new skill directory with SKILL.md). Follows progressive disclosure — skill_read is the activation mechanism that loads full instructions into agent context.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns skill_list, skill_read, skill_create tools
guidelines(): string — XML-wrapped instructions for the skill system

files.description: ToolkitInterface entry point for Coqui Space marketplace integration. Factory wires everything from BootManager: SpaceClient, SkillInstaller, ToolkitInstaller. Provides 3-4 tools: space_skills, space_toolkits, space (manage), space_account (auth-gated). Guidelines include workflow patterns for discover/install/manage flows.
methods: create(BootManager $boot): self — factory method wiring all dependencies from boot
tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns space tools (space_account only when authenticated)
guidelines(): string — LLM context with workflow patterns and tool descriptions
client(): SpaceClient — exposes client for slash commands
skillInstaller(): SkillInstaller — exposes installer for slash commands
toolkitInstaller(): ToolkitInstaller — exposes installer for slash commands

files.description: HTTP client for the Coqui Space REST API. Uses symfony/http-client with closure-based URL/token resolution for hot-reload. Provides search, list, details, versions, reviews, download, install-logging, tags, health, stars, collections, submissions, and /me endpoints.

Constants and helpers for Coqui Space integration. DEFAULT_BASE_URL, ORIGIN_FILE, STATE_FILE. Helpers: isExcluded(), filterExcluded(), extractOwner(). Lists core packages that cannot be managed via the marketplace.

Composer binary resolution and execution. Resolves binary from COMPOSER_BIN env, /opt/homebrew/bin/composer (macOS ARM), /usr/local/bin/composer, /usr/bin/composer, or PATH. Uses proc_open() for stdout/stderr capture with proper HOME/PATH/COMPOSER_HOME env propagation.

Manages toolkit lifecycle via Composer: install, update, disable, enable, remove. Integrated with ToolkitDiscovery to update toolkits.json after every Composer operation. Uses ComposerRunner for binary resolution. State management for disabled toolkits via .space-state.json.

Manages local skill lifecycle: download ZIP, extract, install, update, disable, enable, remove. Integrated with SkillDiscovery to invalidate cache after every modification. Tracks origin via .space-origin.json for update detection.
Agent tool for browsing, installing, and managing skills from Coqui Space. Actions: search, list, details, versions, reviews, file, install, update.
Agent tool for browsing, installing, and managing toolkits from Coqui Space. Actions: search, list, popular, details, reviews, install, update.

Agent tool for managing installed content, social actions, collections, reviews, notifications, tags, and unified search. Actions: installed, disable, enable, remove, star, unstar, submit, tags, search_all, collections, review, notifications, health.

Agent tool for authenticated user dashboard. Only registered when COQUI_SPACE_API_TOKEN is set. Actions: profile, my_skills, my_toolkits, my_collections, my_submissions, my_installs, my_analytics, my_stars.
Value object representing parsed SKILL.md frontmatter. Holds name, description, path, and optional license/compatibility/metadata fields per the AgentSkills specification.

Stateless parser for AgentSkills SKILL.md files. Handles YAML frontmatter extraction, minimal YAML parsing (no ext-yaml dependency), property construction, body extraction, and spec-compliant validation (name format, length limits, allowed fields).
methods: findSkillMd(string $skillDir): ?string — locates SKILL.md or skill.md in a directory
parseFrontmatter(string $content): array — splits YAML frontmatter from markdown body
readProperties(string $skillDir): SkillProperties — parses frontmatter into typed value object
readBody(string $skillDir): string — returns the markdown body (instructions)
validate(string $skillDir): string[] — returns validation errors (empty = valid)
validateName(string $name): string[] — validates name format without directory

files.description: Boot-time skill discovery. Scans workspace/skills/ for directories containing SKILL.md, parses metadata only (progressive disclosure). Provides name resolution, body loading for activation, prompt summary generation, and cache invalidation for newly created skills.
methods: discoverAll(): SkillProperties[] — scans skills directory, returns all valid skills
getSkill(string $name): SkillProperties — resolves name to properties
readBody(string $name): string — returns full instructions for skill activation
skillExists(string $name): bool — checks if a skill exists
buildPromptSummary(): string — generates <available-skills> XML for system prompt
ensureSkillsDir(): void — creates the skills directory if missing
invalidateCache(): void — clears cached discovery results

files.description: Domain exception for SKILL.md parsing failures: missing file, malformed YAML frontmatter, missing required fields.
Domain exception for skill validation failures. Carries an array of individual error strings (name format, length limits, unexpected fields).
Domain exception thrown when a skill name cannot be resolved. Includes the requested name in the message.

SplObserver implementation that streams agent events to the terminal. Handles events: agent.start, agent.iteration, agent.tool_call, agent.tool_result, agent.done, agent.error, child.start, child.end. Manages indent level for nested child agent output.
methods: update(SplSubject $subject): void — dispatches agent events to terminal rendering
handleEvent(string $event, mixed $data): void — direct event handling for child spawn notifications

files.description: No-op SplObserver for headless and API modes where terminal rendering is not desired. Silently discards all events.
methods: update(SplSubject $subject): void — no-op

files.description: SplObserver implementation that writes agent events as Server-Sent Events to a ReactPHP WritableStreamInterface. Maps agent events to SSE event types. Includes writeComplete() for the final result and writeTitle() for generated session titles.
methods: update(SplSubject $subject): void — dispatches agent events as SSE
handleEvent(string $event, mixed $data): void — writes a single SSE event to the stream
writeComplete(array $result): void — writes the final complete SSE event with turn result
writeTitle(string $title): void — writes a title SSE event after completion

files.description: Immutable value object returned by AgentRunner::run(). Contains all turn data: content, token counts, duration, tools used, child agent count, restart flag, and optional error. Has toArray() for JSON serialization and statsSummary() for display.
methods: toArray(): array — serializes to associative array for JSON responses
statsSummary(): string — formatted stats string for terminal display

files.description: Interface separating result rendering from agent execution. Implementations render AgentTurnResult to terminal (TerminalRenderer), JSON (JsonRenderer), or nowhere (NullRenderer).
methods: render(AgentTurnResult $result): void — render a successful turn result
renderError(string $message): void — render an error message

files.description: OutputRendererInterface implementation that renders AgentTurnResult to SymfonyStyle terminal output. Shows 'Assistant:' header, content, and stats summary.
methods: render(AgentTurnResult $result): void
renderError(string $message): void

files.description: OutputRendererInterface implementation that renders AgentTurnResult as JSON to stdout. Used in --no-terminal --format json mode.
methods: render(AgentTurnResult $result): void
renderError(string $message): void

files.description: OutputRendererInterface implementation that discards output. Used in API mode where SSE handles streaming.
methods: render(AgentTurnResult $result): void — no-op
renderError(string $message): void — no-op

files.description: Manages Fiber-based agent execution for the API server. Each prompt runs inside a PHP Fiber.
